acceptanceCriteria: programWriter and leaseAudits exclude per store root, with a test showing two stores proceed concurrently and one store still serializes.
go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tasks/store/ passes; local wall time before/after is recorded in a build-log entry.
A CI run records the shard wall time for internal/tasks/store against the 700s target; a CI -parallel change is made only if that measurement supports it.
body: Follow-up from the store test-speed lane (PR beamfall/corvint#735, decision B two-stage bind). That change added t.Parallel() where safe; the package test took 821s locally and CI is estimated at about 1,100–1,250s, missing the 700s target. Two package-level locks serialize unrelated stores: `var programWriter sync.Mutex` (internal/tasks/store/program.go:18) and `var leaseAudits struct{...}` (internal/tasks/store/lease_write.go:30). Tests on independent temporary repositories still contend on them. Proposal: key both by store root (for example a map of per-root mutexes), preserving the in-process exclusion each provides for a single store. Then measure whether CI should pass `-parallel` explicitly for this package. Unknown: whether any production caller relies on cross-store exclusion; confirm before changing.
title: Tasks store tests: process-wide programWriter and leaseAudits mutexes cap test parallelism in internal/tasks/store
